vuln.name: Legacy CSP Header (X-Content-Security-Policy / X-WebKit-CSP)
vuln.description: Only the legacy X-Content-Security-Policy or X-WebKit-CSP header is present, without the standard Content-Security-Policy header. Modern browsers ignore the legacy headers.
vuln.impact: Modern browsers do not enforce the policy, so the CSP provides no protection for current users.
vuln.recommendation: Set the standard Content-Security-Policy header. The legacy headers may be kept for very old browsers but must not be the only policy.
